items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔承认与汉密尔顿意大利站首圈缠斗“过火”
items.summaryZh: F1意大利大奖赛开场圈，法拉利队友夏尔·勒克莱尔与刘易斯·汉密尔顿激烈缠斗，勒克莱尔赛后承认这次争夺“过火了”。
items.originalTitle: 勒克莱尔承认与汉密尔顿首圈缠斗“过火”
items.summaryEn: Ferrari team-mates Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton fought hard in the opening corners of the Italian Grand Prix, with Leclerc admitting afterwards that the scrap "went too far".
detailZh: 夏尔·勒克莱尔承认，在F1意大利大奖赛的开局弯角中，他与法拉利队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿的缠斗“太过火了”。
从发车区第四位起步的七届世界冠军汉密尔顿，在第一个减速弯冲入内侧，试图超越第三位起步的勒克莱尔。
两人在过弯时并排行驶，但汉密尔顿最终在出弯时被挤进了砂石区——他随后不久告诉比赛工程师“夏尔把我挤出去了”。
当被问及这一事件，以及关于法拉利车手需要协同作战的说法时，在第二圈末尾撞车退赛的勒克莱尔表示：“我真的不知道是谁在强行营造我们彼此对立的说法。”
“在赞德沃特的时候，谈话实在太多了。”
“不过在这里，说实话，我认为我们在第一弯对Lewis的做法确实过火了。然后在第二弯，我试图尽可能紧贴弯心走线，但这还不够，在这里这样做并不好。”
在赞德沃特，Hamilton因法拉利在他使用更新轮胎时没有让车而沮丧地在车队电台发表了强硬的言论，随后一周他就此事进行了道歉。
在蒙扎排位赛后，Hamilton表达了对法拉利执行层面的不满，并表示“我们必须作为一个团队来工作”，以扭转其争夺冠军的希望日益“黯淡”的趋势。
勒克莱尔在帕拉波利卡（阿尔博雷托）弯撞车后前往医疗中心接受检查，但很快便获准离开。
"脖子没事，只是起初视线有点问题，右眼看东西不太清楚，但现在一切都好了，这是我最担心的问题，"勒克莱尔在随后不久接受媒体采访时说道。
"然后在那之后，这里那里有一点疼痛，这在这样的撞车事故后是正常的，仅此而已。"
当被问及在下周于新马德里赛道马德里赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛之前，他将如何从这次失望中振作起来时，勒克莱尔回答说："嗯，首先，我认为今晚和明天我可能还要进行相当多的额外检查，以确保我在马德里能完全恢复良好。"
“按理说应该是这样，但稳妥起见总比后悔好。”
勒克莱尔认为迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的尝试超车并没有导致他的撞车，他说：“我不认为这是问题所在。我觉得从第一圈到第二圈，我的动力输出有一些差异。
“我们会调查一下，但在查看数据并百分之百确认之前，我不想评论太多。”
detailEn: Charles Leclerc admits his scrap with Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton "went too far" during the opening corners of Formula 1's Italian Grand Prix.
From fourth on the grid, seven-time world champion Hamilton went down the inside of third-place starter Leclerc into the first chicane.
They ran side-by-side through the corner, but Hamilton ended up being fed into the gravel on the exit - telling his race engineer shortly afterwards that "Charles pushed me off".

Asked about the incident in the context of talk that the Ferrari drivers need to work together, Leclerc - who crashed out at the end of the second lap - said: "I don't really know who is forcing that narrative that we are one against the other.
"At Zandvoort there were way too many talks already.

"Here it's true, though, that we went too far, I think, [with] Lewis in Turn 1. Then in Turn 2 I tried to do the tightest corner possible, but that was just not enough, and doing it here is not good."

At Zandvoort, Hamilton made some strong team radio comments in frustration at Ferrari not swapping its cars when Hamilton was on fresher tyres, something Hamilton issued an apology for in the week after.
After qualifying at Monza, Hamilton aired his frustration at Ferrari's execution and said "we do have to work as a team" to reverse the trend of its title chances becoming "dimmer".
Leclerc visited the medical centre after his crash at the Parabolica (Alboreto), but was quickly released.

"The neck was OK, it was just the vision a little bit at first, the right eye was not showing me great vision, but now it's all good, so that's the thing I was most worried of getting out of the car," Leclerc said when he spoke to media shortly afterwards.
"Then after that, a bit of pain here and there, which is normal after a crash like this, so nothing more."

Asked how he would pick himself up from that disappointment before next weekend’s Spanish GP at the new Madring circuit, Leclerc replied: "Well, first of all, I think I'll have quite a few additional checks that we still have to do on my side probably tonight and tomorrow to make sure that I'll be fully fine for Madrid.
"It should be the case, but better be safe than sorry."

Leclerc did not think McLaren driver Oscar Piastri trying for a move contributed to his crash, saying: "I wouldn't say that this is the issue. I think from lap one to lap two I had a bit of a difference in power delivery.
"We'll look into it, but I don't want to comment too much before checking the data and confirming it 100%."
keyPointsZh: 七届世界冠军汉密尔顿从第四位发车，在一号减速弯内侧攻击第三位的勒克莱尔。
两车并排过弯后，汉密尔顿在出弯时被挤进砂石区，随后告诉比赛工程师“夏尔把我挤出去了”。
勒克莱尔在第二圈末尾撞车退赛，被问及此事时表示：“我不知道是谁在强行营造我们彼此对立的说法。”
keyPointsEn: Seven-time world champion Hamilton started fourth and attacked third-placed Leclerc down the inside into the first chicane.
After running side-by-side, Hamilton ended up in the gravel at the exit, telling his race engineer "Charles pushed me off".
Leclerc, who crashed out at the end of lap two, said: "I don't really know who is forcing that narrative that we are one against the other."

items.originalTitle: 勒克莱尔在蒙扎撞车后需进一步健康检查
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc says he needs "a few additional checks" following his Italian Grand Prix crash to ensure he will be fit for Formula 1's Madrid round next weekend. He lost control of his Ferrari SF-26 at high speed and hit the wall heavily, causing a red flag.
detailZh: 夏尔·勒克莱尔在蒙扎的一级方程式撞车后需要接受进一步的健康检查
勒克莱尔还不能百分之百确定自己能参加下周的西班牙大奖赛
夏尔·勒克莱尔表示，在意大利大奖赛撞车之后，他需要“进行几项额外的检查”，以确保自己能够以良好的身体状态参加下周在马德里举行的一级方程式比赛。
勒克莱尔在第二圈末尾高速通过帕拉波利卡弯时失去了对法拉利SF-26赛车的控制，并重重撞上了护墙，这次事故导致比赛出示了红旗。
这位摩纳哥车手被送往医疗中心，经检查未发现任何伤情，随后获准离开。
“脖子没事，只是一开始视力有点问题，”勒克莱尔说。“右眼看东西不太清楚，但现在都没问题了，这是我从车上下来的时最担心的事情。”
“除此之外，还有些这里那里的疼痛，发生这样的事故之后这很正常，没有更严重的问题。”
不过，这并不意味着这位28岁车手从事故中脱险后完全没有受伤。
“我想我的身体这边还有相当多额外的检查要做，可能就在今晚和明天进行，以确保我能完全健康地参加马德里站的比赛，”他补充道。“情况应该是这样的，但宁可谨慎小心，也不要事后后悔。”
至于他最初为何失控，勒克莱尔表示是“动力输出上的差异”，但他坚称希望先查看数据，而不是发表没有依据的评论。他也承认自己感到失望。
“是的，这非常令人沮丧，但现在的结果就是这样，我无法改变。我只能向前看，希望能在马德里反弹，”这位法拉利车手最后说道。
detailEn: Charles Leclerc needs further health checks after Monza F1 crash
Leclerc isn’t 100% certain he will race in next weekend’s Spanish Grand Prix
Charles Leclerc says he needs “a few additional checks” following his Italian Grand Prix crash, in order to make sure he’ll be fit next weekend for Formula 1’s Madrid round.
Leclerc lost control of his Ferrari SF-26 at high speed in the Parabolica at the end of lap two and suffered a hefty impact against the wall, which caused a red flag.
The Monegasque was taken to the medical centre, which he was released from in the absence of any detected injuries.

“The neck was OK, it was just the vision a little bit at first,” said Leclerc. “The right eye was not showing me great vision, but now it's all good, so that's the thing I was most worried of getting off the car.
“Then after that everything, a bit of pain here and there, which is normal after a crash like this, so nothing more.”
However, this doesn’t mean the 28-year-old emerged from the accident fully unscathed.

“I think I'll have quite a few additional checks that we still have to do on my side, probably tonight and tomorrow, to make sure that I'll be fully fine for Madrid,” he added. “It should be the case, but better be safe than sorry.”

As to why he lost control in the first place, Leclerc suggested "a difference in power delivery", but insisted he wanted to look at the data rather than make uninformed comments. He also admitted to his disappointment.
“Yeah, it's very frustrating, but it's the way it is now, I cannot change the results. I'll have to look forward and hopefully bounce back in Madrid,” the Ferrari racer concluded.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔严重撞车引发意大利大奖赛提前红旗
items.summaryZh: 夏尔·勒克莱尔在意大利大奖赛第二圈末段于最后一个弯出弯时发生严重撞车，比赛随即被红旗中断。
items.originalTitle: 勒克莱尔重大事故引发意大利大奖赛提前红旗
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc suffered a huge crash at the exit of the final corner at the end of lap two of the Italian Grand Prix, prompting an early red flag.
detailZh: 在第二圈结束时，夏尔·勒克莱尔（勒克莱尔）在最后一个弯道出弯处发生严重撞车后，F1意大利大奖赛被红旗中止。
首圈法拉利两车并排驶入一号弯，汉密尔顿从内侧切入勒克莱尔——在汉密尔顿看来，勒克莱尔随后将他挤出了赛道，使其在二号弯陷入砂石区。
勒克莱尔继续保持在第三位，然后在第二圈开始时短暂超越了杆位起步的皮埃尔·加斯利（加斯利），但随即被反超，后来又跌至第四位，落后于马克斯·维斯塔潘（维斯塔潘）的红牛赛车。
随后勒克莱尔的比赛宣告结束：他在通过Ascari减速弯时出现晃动，在Parabolica（Alboreto）弯失去了对法拉利赛车的控制，高速撞上了护栏。
皮亚斯特里 的迈凯伦当时正寻找机会切入弯角，而 Leclerc 似乎稍稍跑宽，压到了赛道旁的绿色柏油路面，他的法拉利随即发生了甩尾打转。
Leclerc 很快从他撞毁的法拉利中爬了出来，安全车随即出动，随后红旗也迅速亮出。
这次事故与 Leclerc 在 2020 年意大利大奖赛上于 Parabolica 弯撞车的情形非常相似。
法拉利在比赛即将重启前——当地时间下午 3 点 39 分——表示，Leclerc 已经离开了医疗中心。
红旗出示时，乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）处于领先位置，他在第二圈起步时超过了加斯利（Gasly）的阿尔派赛车。
加斯利位列第二，身后依次是维斯塔潘（Verdictappen）、阿尔派车队的第二位车手弗朗哥·科拉平托（科拉平托）、皮亚斯特里（Piastri）、他的迈凯伦队友兰多·诺里斯（诺里斯）、阿维德·林德布拉德（Arvid Lindblad，小红牛车队）以及汉密尔顿（Hamilton）。
detailEn: Formula 1's Italian Grand Prix has been red-flagged following a huge crash for Charles Leclerc on the exit of the final corner at the end of the second lap.

The Ferraris ran side-by-side into the first turn on the opening lap with Hamilton diving down the inside of Leclerc - who, in Hamilton's view, proceeded to push him off the track and into the gravel at Turn 2.
Leclerc continued in third, then briefly overtook polesitter Pierre Gasly at the start of lap two before being repassed, and later dropped to fourth behind Max Verstappen's Red Bull.
And Leclerc's race then came to an end when he had a wobble through the Ascari chicane and lost control of his Ferrari at the Parabolica (Alboreto) and speared into the barriers at high speed.
Oscar Piastri's McLaren had been looking for a move into the corner and Leclerc appeared to run slightly wide onto the green Tarmac just off the track, with his Ferrari swapping ends on him.
Leclerc quickly emerged from his wrecked Ferrari and the safety car, then the red flag, were issued in quick succession.
The incident was similar to Leclerc's crash at Parabolica in the 2020 Italian GP.
Ferrari said shortly before the race was due to restart - at 3.39pm local time - that Leclerc had left the medical centre.
When the red flag was called George Russell led, having overtaken Gasly's Alpine at the start of lap two.
Gasly was second ahead of Verstappen, the second Alpine of Franco Colapinto, Piastri, his McLaren team-mate Lando Norris, Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls) and Hamilton.
keyPointsZh: 首圈汉密尔顿从内侧超越勒克莱尔，后者在汉密尔顿看来在2号弯把他挤出了赛道。
第二圈勒克莱尔曾短暂超越杆位起步的皮埃尔·加斯利后被反超，随后落后于马克斯·维斯塔潘的红牛掉到第四。
他在Ascari减速弯出现晃动后，在帕拉波利卡弯（Alboreto弯）失控，高速撞上护栏退赛。
keyPointsEn: Hamilton dived down the inside of Leclerc on lap one, who in Hamilton's view then pushed him off into the gravel at Turn 2.
Leclerc briefly overtook polesitter Pierre Gasly at the start of lap two before being repassed, then dropped to fourth behind Max Verstappen's Red Bull.
After a wobble through the Ascari chicane, he lost control at the Parabolica (Alboreto) and speared into the barriers at high speed.

detailZh: 巨大撞车导致夏尔·勒克莱尔（勒克莱尔）退出F1意大利大奖赛
勒克莱尔在比赛第2圈发生高速事故后，退出了F1意大利大奖赛
法拉利F1车手夏尔·勒克莱尔在意大利大奖赛中撞车退赛，比赛在蒙扎进行两圈后出示红旗。
在第二圈结束时，勒克莱尔正在防守第四名，抵挡迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里（皮亚斯特里）的进攻，此时这位法拉利车手突然出现转向过度，他的法拉利赛车在高速的帕拉波利卡（Parabolica）右弯中甩出了车尾。
勒克莱尔（Leclerc）高速撞上外侧护栏后发生旋转，但他安然无恙地离开了赛车。不过安全车随后升级为全场红旗，以便赛事官员能够修复护栏。
对于法拉利车队来说，这对主场作战的他们是一个沉重的打击，而比赛开局就已经很糟糕——起步时勒克莱尔把队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿（汉密尔顿）挤到了赛道外侧。汉密尔顿因此跌至第八位，梅赛德斯车队的乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）从意外夺得杆位的阿尔派车队车手皮埃尔·加斯利（加斯利）手中接过了领先位置。
通过车队无线电，汉密尔顿愤怒地表示“夏尔把我挤出了赛道”，但这一事件不会受到赛事干事的调查。
鉴于撞击的严重程度，勒克莱尔前往医疗中心接受了预防性检查，但检查后确认无恙并已获准离开，没有受伤。
当地时间15:39，车手们进行了静止起步重启，车队被允许在暂停期间更换轮胎。
由于Russell将领先于Gasly、维斯塔潘和科拉平托进行重启，积分榜领跑者安东内利从第19位发车（因引擎处罚），一路追赶至第12位。
detailEn: Huge crash knocks Charles Leclerc out of F1 Italian GP
Leclerc was eliminated from Formula 1's Italian Grand Prix after a high-speed accident on lap 2
Ferrari Formula 1 driver Charles Leclerc crashed out of the Italian Grand Prix, bringing out the red flag after two racing laps at Monza.

At the end of the second lap, Leclerc was defending fourth position from McLaren's Oscar Piastri when the Ferrari driver suffered a snap of oversteer and lost the rear of his Ferrari through the fast Parabolica right-hander.
Leclerc spun in the outside barriers at high speed, but walked away unhurt. But a safety car turned into a full red flag so race officials could repair the barriers.

It was a huge blow for Ferrari at its home race, which had already suffered a poor start when Leclerc pushed team-mate Lewis Hamilton wide at the start. Hamilton was demoted to eighth, with Mercedes' George Russell taking over the lead from surprise polesitter Pierre Gasly in the Alpine.
On the team radio, Hamilton fumed that "Charles pushed me off", an incident that will not be investigated by the stewards.
Given the severity of the impact, Leclerc headed to the medical centre for precautionary checks, but was cleared and released without injuries.
Drivers are took a standing restart at 15:39 local time, with teams allowed to make a tyre change during the stoppage.
As Russell will lead the restart from Gasly, Max Verstappen and Franco Colapinto, championship leader Kimi Antonelli worked his way up to 12th after starting down in 19th due to an engine penalty.

detailZh: 科尔顿·赫塔（Colton Herta）的2026赛季从糟糕变得更糟——两次冲出赛道，还在蒙扎遭遇一次赛车故障
在意大利的这个周末，赫塔可能经历了整个赛季最艰难的比赛，而他的F1梦想也随之脱轨
科尔顿·赫塔（Colton Herta）的F2赛季正从糟糕变得更糟，而他在蒙扎的这个周末最能说明这一点。
曾几何时是IndyCar领先车手的赫塔，被凯迪拉克F1车队聘为2026年的测试与发展车手，并转战F2，为可能晋级世界锦标赛做准备。
不过，虽然F2本来就注定充满挑战——他没有倍耐力轮胎的使用经验，也不熟悉这些赛道——但Herta目前在积分榜上仅排在第17位，成绩令人失望。
在10轮比赛中，这位Hitech车手只有一次排位赛进入前12名，而蒙扎更是他的新低谷：仅列第20位，落后领先者超过一秒。
但问题不仅仅在于速度。Herta在唯一一节F2练习赛中冲出赛道退赛，他在Lesmo 2弯出口处把两个车轮压进了砂石区，随后打旋转入内侧护栏。之后他参加了F1的一练，以满足凯迪拉克的新秀出场要求，但他的MAC-赛车在仅完成一个飞驰圈后就因疑似液压故障而抛锚。F2排位赛第20名的成绩更是让他这一天雪上加霜。
这是Herta第三次参加一练，他在凯迪拉克赛车里已经感觉“舒服得多”。“你知道的，就是对赛车需要什么、想要怎样被驾驶多了一点点了解，”他解释道。
“所有这些赛车都有一些微小的差异，正是这些差异让它们变得合拍。我在驾驶时努力去找到这种感觉，所以对赛车喜欢什么样的特性多一分了解就是很大的帮助，这让我感觉更自在。
“当你只有一个小时的时候，就好像，真的，当你坐在车里、一切都发生的时候，一切都进展得飞快。感觉你在车里只待了五分钟，所以你一下车就立刻会想，‘哦，我本该做这个’或者‘我本该做那个’。
“我想每个人都会说，如果在驾驶中任何事情上得到第二次机会，他们都会做得更好，对我来说肯定也是这样，那可能会是一个相当大的进步。
随后在周六的F2冲刺赛中，Herta仅获得第15名，而他的主赛在第11圈就结束了——他在Parabolica弯出口冲进了砂石区；当时他正排在第21位。
结果，他在积分榜上卡在了26分，过去10场比赛只拿到过一次前12名的完赛成绩。他与总冠军领跑者Nikola Tsolov之间相差151分，而剩下四轮总共只有156分可争，这意味着他在数学上几乎已经无缘总冠军。就连目前相差37分的前十名，现在看来也是一项艰巨的任务。
“我想做的是进入F1，而且我想尽快到达那里，”Herta说，“这有多现实，我还没有被告知，也不知道。”但2027年的F1席位几乎已经不再是一个选择了。
detailEn: Colton Herta’s 2026 season goes from bad to worse – two offs, one breakdown at Monza
Herta probably endured his toughest weekend of the campaign in Italy, as his F1 dream gets derailed
Colton Herta’s Formula 2 season has been going from bad to worse, which nothing illustrates more clearly than his Monza weekend.
Former IndyCar frontrunner Herta was hired by the Cadillac Formula 1 team as a test and development driver for 2026, and he switched to F2 ahead of a potential graduation to the world championship.
But while F2 was always going to be a challenge, given he had no experience of the Pirelli rubber and wasn’t familiar with the tracks, Herta lies an underwhelming 17th in the standings.
Over 10 rounds, the Hitech driver has qualified in the top 12 just once, and Monza was a new low for him with 20th place, more than a second off the pace.

It wasn’t just about pace, though. Herta crashed out of the only F2 practice session when he put two wheels in the gravel at the exit of Lesmo 2 and spun into the inside wall. He then partook in Formula 1 FP1 as Cadillac fulfilled its rookie requirements, but his MAC-26 broke down after just one push lap with a suspected hydraulic issue. That 20th position in F2 qualifying compounded his troubled day.

This was Herta’s third FP1 outing, and he had been feeling “a lot more” comfortable in the Cadillac. “You know, just kind of having that little bit of knowledge about what the car wants, or what the car needs, how it wants to be driven,” he explained.

“All these cars have tiny differences that make them click. I'm driving and trying to find that, so having a bit more knowledge of what the car likes to do is a big help, it makes me feel more comfortable.

“When you only have an hour, it seems like, literally when you're inside the car and everything's happening, everything's happening so quick. It seems like you're in there for five minutes, so you get out and you're instantly like, ‘Oh I should have done this’ or ‘I should have done that’.
“I think everybody would say if they get a second chance at anything when they're driving they would do better, and for sure for me it probably would have been a pretty big step.”
Herta then progressed to just 15th place in the F2 sprint race on Saturday, and his feature race ended on lap 11, in the gravel at the exit of Parabolica; he was running 21st.

As a consequence, he’s stuck on 26 points in the standings, having taken just one top 12 finish in the last 10 races. His 151-point deficit to championship leader Nikola Tsolov, with 156 available in the remaining four rounds, means he’s all but mathematically out of contention for the title. Even the top 10, now 37 points away, currently seems like a tall order.

“What I want to do is I want to get to Formula 1 and I want to get there as fast as possible,” Herta said. “How realistic that is, I have yet to be told or know.” But a 2027 F1 drive can hardly be an option anymore.

塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔在蒙扎驾驶迈克尔·舒马赫的法拉利F2002进行的表演行驶让F1车迷们感慨万分
四届F1世界冠军塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔在意大利大奖赛赛前驾驶迈克尔·舒马赫的法拉利F2002进行的表演行驶，引发了车迷们的情感共鸣。
周日，这位德国车手驾驶使用可持续燃料的法拉利赛车驶上蒙扎赛道，向他的童年偶像致敬。本周末的意大利大奖赛旨在纪念舒马赫在法拉利F1首秀30周年。
法拉利F2002仍然是F1历史上最具统治力的赛车之一，在2002和2003两个赛季中取得了15场胜利。曾在2015年至2020年间为这支马拉内罗车队效力的维特尔，在法拉利车迷面前驾驶这辆标志性赛车，在社交媒体上引发了情感的大量涌动。
对于许多人来说，2000年代初期V10引擎的轰鸣声是首要的讨论话题。"你根本无法超越那种声音。简直是我们的天籁之音，"一位车迷在Reddit上评论道，另一位则补充说："那种声音太动人了。现在的赛车根本不在同一个档次。"
"美丽的赛车，美丽的声音，由除了伟大的车王本人之外最合适驾驶它的人来驾驭。迈克尔永远无法在退役后拥有这样的时刻，永远无法感受到人们对他成就的赞赏以及对这项运动所创造回忆的怀念，这真的让我很难过。在这些时刻，因为他的缺席而有一种空虚感，"另一位车迷写道。
"那种声音让我又快乐又悲伤。为那些回忆和它的绝对震撼而快乐。悲伤的是我们再也看不到一整排这样的赛车同场竞速了，"另一条评论写道，还有人写道："我完全没有想到这会让我如此动情。那辆车和迈克尔是我青春中如此重要的一部分，也是我爱上这项运动的重要原因。没有人比Seb更适合驾驶它了。"
进一步的反应包括：“他们需要带一辆经典F1赛车去每场比赛并做这件事，这样所有人都能听到它的伟大”，以及“我现在就在赛道现场，看着那辆车唱着歌驶过，然后是Seb赛后的讲话。真的让我热泪盈眶。
detailEn: F1 fans left emotional after Sebastian Vettel drives Michael Schumacher's Ferrari F2002 at Monza
Sebastian Vettel’s demonstration run in Michael Schumacher’s Ferrari F2002 at Monza left F1 fans emotional
Four-time Formula 1 champion Sebastian Vettel's demonstration run in Michael Schumacher's Ferrari F2002 ahead of the Italian Grand Prix has triggered an emotional response from fans.

With the Ferrari running on sustainable fuel, the German driver took to the Monza circuit on Sunday to pay tribute to his childhood hero. This weekend's Italian Grand Prix celebrates 30 years since Schumacher's Ferrari F1 debut.

The Ferrari F2002 remains one of the most dominant cars in F1 history, securing 15 victories across the 2002 and 2003 seasons. Seeing Vettel, who raced for the Maranello outfit between 2015 and 2020, pilot the iconic car in front of the Tifosi led to an outpouring of emotion on social media.

The sound of the early-2000s V10 machinery was the primary talking point for many. "You just can't beat that sound. Music to our ears," one fan commented on Reddit, while another added: "That noise is so emotive. Modern cars aren't in the same league."

"Beautiful car, beautiful sound, driven by the most fitting person to drive it other than the great man himself. Really saddens me that Michael will never get to have these moments in retirement and the appreciation for his achievements and the memories he created for the sport. There’s a void with him missing during these times," another fan posted.

"That sound makes me so happy and so sad. Happy for the memories and the absolute awesomeness of it. Sad that we will never have a grid of those cars racing ever again," another comment read, while someone else wrote: "I was not prepared for how emotional this actually made me. That car and Michael were such a huge part of my youth and a big part of why I fell in love with this sport. And there is nobody more fitting to drive it than Seb."

Further reactions included: "They need to bring a classic F1 car to every race and do this so everyone can hear the greatness," and "I'm at the circuit right now, watching that car go by while singing and then Seb's words afterwards. Tears to my eyes, really."

四届一级方程式世界冠军塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔在蒙扎为意大利车迷驾驶其好友迈克尔·舒马赫2002年的法拉利赛车进行展示行驶后，激动不已。
作为蒙扎赛前活动的一部分，Vettel 驾驶 F2002 完成了几圈行驶，这个周末法拉利正在纪念 Schumacher 1996 年在车队首秀 30 周年。
线条流畅的 F2002 是让-托德（Jean Todt）和罗斯·布朗（Ross Brawn）时代马拉内罗巅峰时期的产物，它助力 Schumacher 拿下 11 场胜利，队友鲁本斯·巴里切罗（Rubens Barrichello）拿下 5 场胜利，车队只输了全年比赛中的两场。
那一年 Schumacher 从未跌出领奖台，在赛季第 11 站法国大奖赛之后，他于 7 月底便锁定了自己连续第三个、也是总第五个法拉利冠军头衔。
但比起赛车本身的历史，真正让 Schumacher 的朋友和门徒 Vettel 深受触动的是这位七届世界冠军留下的传奇——自 2013 年 12 月滑雪事故以来，他再也没有在公开场合露面。
“我的心情复杂，百感交集，”维特尔在展示结束后说道，他几乎要落泪。“一方面，驾驶这辆车真是太美妙了。它是一件如此精美的机器。但更重要的是，这是迈克尔的车。他今天不在这里，但在这些圈里我强烈地感受到了他，我希望你们也听到了他的声音、感受到了他的存在。”
这位四届世界冠军曾在2015年至2020年间效力于法拉利，试图重现舒马赫的辉煌岁月。他说，他心中在两种想法之间徘徊：一方面想让这个独特的时刻尽可能延续下去，另一方面又想踩下那台强劲的V10发动机的油门。
“太令人兴奋了，”维特尔描述道，兴奋得明显浑身颤抖。“不需要跑多少圈就能感受到一辆车的灵魂，你立刻就能感觉到这是一辆特别的车，它就像在对你尖叫‘冲、冲、冲’。”
“我一直很纠结，一方面我想开快这辆车，另一方面我又想享受这个时刻、让它延续下去。但无论如何，这一切都太美好了，能感受到迈克尔的精神在这里多么鲜活，法拉利的精神在这里多么鲜活。多年以前我自己就体验过这一切。”
他补充道："有些东西我很怀念，但这是另一种生活，正如我所说，照顾下一代车手，前方还有很好的机会。所以，今天是非常激动人心的一天。我的心在跳动，我非常非常自豪，我也很怀念迈克尔（Michael）。"

detailEn: WATCH: Sebastian Vettel pays emotional Michael Schumacher tribute in Ferrari F2002 - "I felt him a lot today"
Watch Vettel's emotional demo run in the Ferrari F2002 Formula 1 car as he paid tribute to Schumacher at the Italian Grand Prix in Monza
Sebastian Vettel drives a historic Ferrari
Four-time Formula 1 world champion Sebastian Vettel was overcome with emotion after treating the Italian fans at Monza to a demo run in his friend Michael Schumacher's 2002 Ferrari.
Vettel completed a handful of laps in the F2002 as part of the pre-race activities at Monza, on a weekend where Ferrari celebrated the 30th anniversary of Schumacher's debut with the team in 1996.

The sleek F2002 was a product of Maranello at the peak of its powers in the Jean Todt and Ross Brawn era, propelling Schumacher to 11 wins and team-mate Rubens Barrichello to five victories as the team won all but two races.
Schumacher never finished off the podium that year, clinching his third consecutive title with Ferrari and his fifth overall by the end of July, after the 11th grand prix of the season in France.

But more than the history of the car itself, what shook Schumacher's friend and protege Vettel to his core was the legacy of the seven-time world champion, who has not been seen in public since a ski accident in December 2013.

"I'm caught and mixed up in feelings," Vettel said after the demonstration as he was on the verge of tears. "On the one hand it's such a beautiful car to drive. It's such a beautiful piece of machinery. But much more, it's Michael's car. He's not here today but I felt him a lot in these laps, and I hope you heard him and felt him as well."

The four-time world champion, a Ferrari driver himself between 2015 and 2020 as he tried to emulate Schumacher's glory years, said he was in two minds between letting the unique moment last as long as possible and stepping on the powerful V10 engine's tail.

"It's so exciting," Vettel described, visibly shaking with glee. "It doesn't take many laps to sense the soul of a car, and you sense immediately that it was a special car and it's just screaming at you like 'Go, go, go,'.

"I was all the time torn between I want to push this car and I would enjoy the moment and make it last but no, it's been absolutely beautiful and to feel how alive Michael's spirit is and how alive Ferrari's spirit is around here. I experienced it myself years ago."

He added: "There's bits that I miss but it's a different life and looking after the next generation of drivers as I said, there's great opportunities ahead. So, it's a very emotional day. My heart is beating and I'm very, very proud and I miss Michael."

detailZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索和利亚姆·劳森将从维修区发车参加F1意大利大奖赛
阿斯顿·马丁和红牛违反了赛车封闭规则，因此阿隆索和劳森将无法从发车格发车
费尔南多·阿隆索和利亚姆·劳森将于今天下午在蒙扎从维修区发车，参加F1意大利大奖赛。
两辆赛车都违反了赛车封闭规则，因为阿斯顿·马丁选择为阿隆索更换全新的动力单元部件——一个MGU-K电机、一块电池和一个控制电子单元——而他此前已经超出了年度配额。
阿斯顿·马丁的一份声明写道：“昨天在第一节排位赛中，我们在（数据中）发现费尔南多赛车的部分动力单元组件出现了一些异常表现。这导致费尔南多无法在排位赛中完成最后一轮飞行圈。我们因此通宵对赛车进行了检修，费尔南多的赛车将从维修区发车。
与此同时，红牛更换了劳森的尾翼并微调了他的悬挂设置，这位新西兰车手自法国车手伊萨克·哈贾尔在夏休期训练中手腕受伤以来一直代打，目前仍在努力适应小红牛22赛车。
在第二节排位赛中被奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里阻挡、最终仅排在第14位之后，劳森此前已经启用了额外的引擎部件，所以无论如何他本来也要从发车区末位起步。
阿隆索在排位赛中仅列第21位，远逊于凯迪拉克赛车的速度，原定第18位发车。在蒙扎这条高速赛道上，搭载本田动力的AMR26一直被预期会陷入挣扎——尽管他还受到了前述动力单元问题的影响。
“我们知道这条赛道，尤其是拉斯维加斯，对我们来说会是最糟糕、最具挑战性的一站，”这位两届F1世界冠军说。
“我们损失很多，在直道上差距很大。数据摆在所有人面前。我们并不盲目，我们和你们看到的是同样的数据，我们知道需要在动力方面下功夫。但我们正在努力互相支持，我认为明年的目标已经很明确了。”
detailEn: Fernando Alonso and Liam Lawson will start F1 Italian GP from pitlane
Aston Martin and Red Bull breached parc ferme rules, so Alonso and Lawson won’t start from the grid
Fernando Alonso and Liam Lawson are set to start the Formula 1 Italian Grand Prix from the pitlane this afternoon at Monza.

Parc ferme rules were breached on both cars, as Aston Martin opted to give Alonso fresh power unit parts – an MGU-K, a battery and a control electronics unit – having already exceeding his yearly allowance previously.

“Yesterday in Q1 we identified some abnormal behaviour (in the data) on some of the PU components of Fernando's car,” an Aston Martin statement read. “This prevented Fernando from completing a final run in qualifying. We worked on the car overnight as a result and Fernando's car will start the race from the pitlane.”

Meanwhile, Red Bull changed Lawson’s rear wing and tweaked his suspension set-up, as the New Zealander continues to get to grips with the RB22, having stood in for Isack Hadjar since the Frenchman injured his wrist in training over the summer break.
After being impeded by Oscar Piastri in Q2 and qualifying down in 14th, Lawson had already been given extra engine parts, so would have started the race from the back of the grid anyway.

Alonso was supposed to line up in 18th after qualifying 21st, well off the pace of the Cadillacs, at a high-speed Monza track where the Honda-powered AMR26 was always expected to struggle – though he was hampered by the aforementioned power unit issue.
“We knew that this track, with Vegas it's going to be the worst for us and the most challenging,” the two-time F1 world champion said.

“We lose a lot, there's a big deficit on the straights. The data is there for everyone. We are not blind, we see the same data as you guys and we know that we need to work on the power. But we are trying to support each other and I think there are clear targets for next year.”

items.summaryZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利在蒙扎以最出人意料的方式夺得职业生涯首个杆位，六年前他曾随AlphaTauri在蒙扎赢下一场最不可预测的F1比赛。阿尔派为此重新启用了此前搁置的折叠式尾翼。

items.originalTitle: Alpine为加斯利蒙扎杆位带回折叠式尾翼
items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly claimed the first pole position of his career at Monza in the most unexpected way, six years after winning there with AlphaTauri in one of the most unpredictable F1 races ever. Alpine brought back its folding rear wing as part of the low-downforce configuration.
detailZh: 阿尔派在加斯利蒙扎杆位之前重新启用可折叠尾翼
作为阿尔派低下压力套件的一部分，带有两片可收拢襟翼的可折叠尾翼在2026年F1赛季前三场比赛后被搁置之后重新回归
有神奇的日子，也有特别的地方。对加斯利来说，蒙扎就是其中之一。在他用AlphaTauri夺冠六年之后——那是有史以来最难以预测的F1比赛之一——这位法国车手以最出人意料的方式夺得了他职业生涯的第一个杆位。
就连阿尔派自己也未曾预料到能参与到最前排位置的争夺中，尤其是考虑到周六开始时的目标只是进入排位赛前十名。从自由练习赛的情况来看，这是一个相当现实且可以实现的目标，车队在与小红牛竞争，虽然不那么稳定，也在与奥迪较量。
最终的成绩比任何人预期的都要理想得多，但这并不是一个靠运气得来的杆位。它是在赛道上应得并挣来的。当然，尾流博弈也发挥了作用，而且不可否认的是，如果不是在最后一次尝试中与 维斯塔潘 发生纠葛，拉塞尔 领衔的 梅赛德斯 实际上还有更大的余量。但你必须抓住这样的机会。
阿尔派 正是这么做的。A526 这辆车，尤其是带到蒙扎的配置，与其他车队相比产生的空气阻力相对较小，这无疑在长直道上很有帮助。甚至在自由练习中，就能看到 Enstone 车队在直道上录得了出色的尾速。挑战在于找到正确的过弯平衡，而不损失太多。
不过，本周末的这个杆位还有一个有趣的方面，因为这套低下压力套件中还包含了一位“老熟人”：反向开启的后翼，它会使两片襟翼塌陷。这一方案曾在测试以及赛季前三场比赛——澳大利亚、中国和铃鹿——中出现过，之后被搁置，转而采用与去年 DRS 类似的更常规的开启机制。
阿尔派 新颖的后翼组件在蒙扎重新亮相
因此，低下压力套件重新启用了赛季初期的尾翼，同时尾翼作动器上所有附加部件都已被移除。阿尔派 实际上是本赛季第一支在铃鹿站围绕开翼机制引入专门结构以获取更多气动载荷的车队，由此开启了一个随后被所有其他车队效仿的趋势。
然而，在蒙扎这样的赛道上，所有这些旨在产生更多下压力的附加部件被认为没有必要，因此被拆除，实际上回归到了年初的第一版规格。这一版本被认为效率更高，包括其与扩散器的相互作用。
值得一提的是，两周前在赞德福特，阿尔派 推出了一套酝酿已久的重要技术升级包。借助它，A526 找回了一直缺失的一部分下压力，这在高速弯中尤为有用。
这并不意味着 阿尔派 突然成为了过弯性能方面的标杆赛车。更确切地说，它是找到了那几公里每小时所需的速度，从而避免在直道上丢掉原本获得的那些优势。
“我们新加装的套件阻力并不大，这在这条赛道上是件好事。我们的极速不是什么秘密，你们都看得到，它很有竞争力。所以，谁知道呢？让我们看看能做到什么吧。”阿尔派 车队董事总经理 Steve Nielsen 解释道。
detailEn: Alpine brings back folding rear wing ahead of Pierre Gasly’s Monza pole
As part of Alpine’s low-downforce configuration, the folding rear wing with two collapsing flaps made a return after being shelved following the first three races of the 2026 F1 season

There are magical days, but there are also special places. Monza is one of them for Pierre Gasly. Six years after his triumph with AlphaTauri, in what was one of the most unpredictable Formula 1 races ever, the Frenchman took the first pole position of his career in the most unexpected way possible.

Even Alpine itself had not predicted that it could get involved in the fight for the very top positions, especially considering that the target at the start of Saturday had been to make the top 10 in qualifying. That was a more than realistic and achievable goal based on what was seen in free practice, with the team fighting Racing Bulls and, albeit inconsistently, Audi.

The final classification was much more favourable than anyone could have expected, but this was not a pole position produced by chance. It was deserved and earned on track. Certainly, the slipstreaming games played their part, and it cannot be denied that Mercedes realistically had more margin with George Russell had he not been involved in a fracas with Max Verstappen on his final attempt. But you have to capitalise on such opportunities.

That is exactly what Alpine did. The A526 is a car that, particularly in the configuration brought to Monza, generates relatively little aerodynamic drag compared with other teams, and that undoubtedly helps on the long straights. Even in free practice, it was possible to see that the Enstone team was recording excellent top speeds on the straights. The challenge was finding the right balance through the corners without giving too much away.

There is, however, an interesting aspect to this weekend’s pole position, because the low-downforce package also featured an old acquaintance: the rear wing that opens in reverse, causing the two flaps to collapse. This solution had been seen in testing and during the first three races of the season – Australia, China and Suzuka – before being set aside in favour of a more conventional opening mechanism similar to last year’s DRS.
Alpine novel rear wing assembly made a comeback in Monza

The low-downforce package has therefore brought back the early-season wing, while all the additional elements on the wing actuator have been removed. Alpine was actually the first team this season to introduce dedicated structures around the wing-opening mechanism at Suzuka in order to find more aerodynamic load, starting a trend that was subsequently adopted by all the other teams.

On a circuit like Monza, however, all those additional elements aimed at generating more downforce were not considered necessary and were removed, effectively returning to the very first specification from the beginning of the year. That version was considered more efficient, including in its interaction with the diffuser.

It is worth remembering that at Zandvoort two weeks ago, Alpine introduced a major package of long-awaited technical upgrades. With it, the A526 found some of the downforce it had been lacking, and this was particularly useful in the high-speed corners.

That does not mean that Alpine has suddenly become a benchmark car in terms of cornering performance. Rather, it has managed to find those few extra km/h needed to avoid throwing away what it gains on the straights.

“The new package we put on is not very draggy, which is good here. Our top speed is no secret. You can see that. It's competitive. So, who knows? Let's see what we can do,” explained Steve Nielsen, Alpine’s managing director.

detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿对法拉利在蒙扎F1排位赛中的执行表现感到不满
汉密尔顿在车队的主场排位赛中获得第五名，他觉得车队本可以做得更好
刘易斯·汉密尔顿有些含蓄地表达了对法拉利在F1意大利大奖赛排位赛中执行表现的不满
汉密尔顿在Q1中排名第八，在Q2中以仅0.001秒的优势惊险晋级，最终在Q3中获得第五名，尽管他仅落后杆位得主皮埃尔·加斯利0.225秒，他仍然对此感到失望。
法拉利排位赛的轮换安排意味着汉密尔顿本周末可以选择是出站在队友夏尔·勒克莱尔之前还是之后；这位七届世界冠军合理地选择了第二个出站，以便在“速度圣殿”利用这位摩纳哥车手的尾流。
然而，由于轮胎准备得不够及时，汉密尔顿在Q3第一次飞行圈中没有获得那条尾流，而他在第二次尝试时仍然比队友的赛车慢——慢了0.007秒。
当被问及车手之间的配合在蒙扎是否重要时，这位英国车手沉思了几秒钟，然后避重就轻地回答说：“我能说的是，皮埃尔干得很棒。显然，从远处看，他们作为一个团队配合得非常好。”
他接着补充道：“车队唯一的关注点就是尽量让每位车手获得同等的尾流。而且，正如我所说，我们只是搞砸了。
夏尔·勒克莱尔（勒克莱尔），法拉利；刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
由于奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里因阻挡利亚姆·劳森被罚退三位，法拉利两车最终将锁定发车第二排，不过汉密尔顿清楚自己并不是夺冠热门。
“这样一来，希望我们能和乔治（拉塞尔）有一战之力。梅赛德斯只有一辆车在前排，所以希望这给了我们机会，”他说。
“乔治拥有最快的赛车，这很明显。尤其是你看看他的梅赛德斯就知道了。我们在直道上仍然处于劣势，但现实就是如此。”
随着F1赛季的推进，汉密尔顿对自己的夺冠前景愈发不确定，他目前落后安东内利59分。
“隧道尽头有光，但我们走得越深，那光就越暗淡，”他感叹道。“尽管车队在带来升级、推动我们前进方面做得非常出色——我为此感到无比骄傲，我总是这么说，但那是因为我确实如此——不过在赛道上，我们也需要拿出正确的状态、做出相应的行动，以确保取得我们所需要的结果。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton unhappy with Ferrari execution in Monza F1 qualifying
Hamilton felt the Scuderia could have done better after ending up fifth in qualifying on its home turf
Lewis Hamilton has somewhat implicitly expressed dissatisfaction with Ferrari’s execution in qualifying at Formula 1’s Italian Grand Prix.
Hamilton was eighth-fastest in Q1, made it out of Q2 by just 0.001s, and ended up fifth in Q3, which he was disappointed with despite being just 0.225s down on polesetter Pierre Gasly.

Ferrari’s qualifying rota meant Hamilton could choose whether to go out ahead of team-mate Charles Leclerc or behind him this weekend; the seven-time world champion logically opted to go second in order to benefit from the Monegasque’s tow in the ‘Temple of Speed’.
However, Hamilton failed to get that slipstream on his first Q3 run due to his tyres being prepared tardily, and he still was slower than the sister car on his second attempt – by 0.007s.

Asked about the cooperation between team-mates being important in Monza, the Briton pondered the question for a few seconds before deflectively replying: “What I can say is, Pierre did a great job. Clearly, looking from a distance, it looked like they worked really well as a team.”
He went on to add: “The team was solely focused on trying to get an equal tow for each driver. And, as I said, we just stumbled.”
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

The Ferraris will eventually lock out the second row for the race, courtesy of Oscar Piastri’s three-place grid penalty for impeding Liam Lawson, though Hamilton is aware he’s not the favourite for victory.
“That puts us in fighting chance, hopefully, with George [Russell]. That's one Mercedes up front, so hopefully that gives us a chance,” he said.
“George has the fastest car, that's clear. Particularly if you see his Mercedes. We're lacking on straights still, and that's just the way it is.”
And as the F1 season goes on, Hamilton grows more uncertain as to his title chances, with his deficit to Antonelli currently 59 points.

“There's light at the end of the tunnel, but it's getting dimmer the further we get through,” he deplored. “And even though the team's doing an amazing job in bringing upgrades and pushing us forward – I'm so proud of everyone, I say it all the time, but it's because I really am – also at the track, we need to come correct and act accordingly to make sure we get the result we need.”
